summary: The twelve stored chip climbs were replayed and matched the stored chip file. Ten of twelve Gameweek 4 wildcards clear 16 on the priced steps. The chip week is positive on every climb, and in 2022/23 the weeks with no chip are the loss. All eight second-half wildcards in 2023/24 and 2025/26 miss 16 on the priced steps. Gemini kept the split. The margins stay 12 and 16. Bounding the wildcard sum is a later batch.
